records.title: High-harmonic generation during ultrafast melting of a Mott insulating state
records.description: High-harmonic spectroscopy under an intense mid-infrared field reveals redshifts of high-harmonic peaks during the ultrafast melting of a Mott insulating state, while dynamical mean-field theory links them to cycle-by-cycle electronic-state changes.

records.title: All-optical thin-film lithium niobate memristor
records.description: Oxygen-ion implantation allows the direct fabrication of photonic memristors in thin-film lithium niobate. The resulting devices combine 3-bit non-volatile optical memory, submicrosecond responses and femtojoule-level switching energies.

records.title: Pure-blue quantum-dot light-emitting diodes with minimal efficiency roll-off and high brightness
records.description: Quantum dots with compositionally graded shells enhance quantum-dot LED performance, achieving pure-blue emission with a peak external quantum efficiency of 23.8%, 95% of which is retained at a luminance of 50,000 cd m −2 .

records.title: Light-switch for nerve cells
Optical control stabilizes cold-atom comagnetometry
records.description: The use of tailored laser fields improves the coherence times of two co-trapped ytterbium isotopes, resulting in the rejection of magnetic-field noise by more than thirty-thousand-fold, opening the way to improved comagnetometry.

records.title: Measuring hard X-ray attosecond pulses
records.description: The generation and characterization of high-power X-ray attosecond pulses is a challenging research frontier in free-electron laser science. Now, researchers at the Linac Coherent Light Source have demonstrated experimental confirmation and measurement of hard X-ray pulses reaching 100-attosecond durations.

records.title: Femtosecond lasers drive nanostructuring and green applications
records.description: From ultra-precise nanofabrication to sustainable use cases, femtosecond lasers continue to expand their application potential.

records.title: Workhorse solid-state lasers reinvented
records.description: Miniature versions of famous bulk solid-state sources, notably titanium–sapphire and Nd:YAG lasers, have now become a reality. This advance has been made possible through collaborative efforts from material science, heterogeneous integration and fabrication technologies.

records.title: Infrared polymer boasts high index and transparency
records.description: A bifunctional cyano-substitution synthetic strategy yields an all-organic polymer with a record-breaking refractive index of 2.53 at 750 nm, combining high infrared transparency with mechanical flexibility and solution-processability.

records.title: Low-voltage avalanche heterojunction phototransistor for infrared-to-visible upconversion
records.description: Researchers demonstrate infrared-to-visible upconversion using an InGaAs/InP avalanche heterojunction phototransistor. Intrinsic positive feedback provides the photocurrent for amber LED operation, producing visible emission 17,000 times brighter than incident infrared light with a breakdown voltage as low as 1.4 V.

records.title: Deep subwavelength laser nanofabrication via upconversion
records.description: Upconversion brings new opportunities for high-resolution laser fabrication.

records.title: Automatic on-chip separation of partially coherent light into its mutually incoherent components
records.description: Partial coherence often limits imaging and optical information processing. Researchers demonstrate a photonic chip that separates partially coherent light into its coherence modes, enabling scalable coherence analysis with resources that scale linearly with mode rank.

records.title: Ligand-engineered CsEuI 3 nanocrystals for efficient single-component white electroluminescence
records.description: Ligand-engineered CsEuI 3 nanocrystals enable efficient single-component white electroluminescence with a peak external quantum efficiency of 8.3% and integration into active-matrix full-colour displays.

records.title: Regulating the crystallization of thermally evaporated perovskites for efficient near-infrared light-emitting diodes
records.description: Dual-amide additives regulate the crystallization of thermally evaporated perovskites, enabling near-infrared perovkite LEDs with a peak external quantum efficiency of 25.0%, highlighting their potential for scalable pixelated optoelectronics.

records.title: Narrow-linewidth, piezoelectrically tunable photonic integrated blue laser
records.description: Combining a gallium nitride laser diode with a high- Q silicon nitride microresonator results in a low-noise integrated blue laser.

records.title: Solution-processed nano-LEDs for next-generation optoelectronic technologies
records.description: This Review covers recent advances in quantum dots and perovskite nano-LEDs, discusses the challenge of balancing efficiency, stability and full-colour integration, and highlights potential future applications.

records.title: Experimental demonstration of attosecond hard X-ray pulses
records.description: Researchers experimentally demonstrate attosecond pulse generation in the hard X-ray regime with a free-electron laser. The confirmation is enabled via the measurement of amplified spontaneous emission from 3 d transition metals. Pulse durations are in the range of 100 as to 400 as.

records.title: Intrinsic backward emission of coherent Raman photons from homogeneous media
records.description: Backscattered coherent Raman microscopy brings new opportunities.

records.title: Controllable transient coherent state reproduction in lasers
records.description: By periodically resetting the pump power, a Fourier-domain mode-locked laser achieves a 2.5-kHz linewidth, exploiting the high coherence of a transient initial stabilization state.

records.title: Perovskite chiral multiple quantum wells with extended spin lifetime via efficient spin cascade
records.description: Chiral multiple quantum wells enhance spin coherence in perovskites through spin cascade, achieving over 5-ns spin lifetime at room temperature.

records.title: Nonlinear circular dichroism reveals the local Berry curvature
records.description: The nonlinear high harmonic circular dichroism for crystals with broken time-reversal symmetry is found to be directly proportional to the local Berry curvature, and it can be directly probed via ultrafast all-optical measurements.

records.title: Intermolecular decoupling of C 60 suppresses interfacial recombination in perovskite solar cells
records.description: Interfacial recombination in perovskite solar cells is mitigated through a vapour-phase molecular passivation method using trialkylamines, disrupting C 60 packing. This approach results in a power conversion efficiency of up to 27.2% while maintaining stability.

records.title: Solid-state emissive acceptors enable thermally accessible radiative pathways for efficient organic solar cells
records.description: Solid-state emissive guest acceptors enhance organic solar cells by establishing thermally accessible radiative pathways, significantly reducing non-radiative voltage loss end enabling ternary blend devices with a certified power conversion efficiency of 20.84%.

records.title: Stable deep-blue organic light-emitting diodes with reduced efficiency roll-off via accelerated exciton utilization
records.description: Deep-blue organic light-emitting diodes leveraging phosphor-assisted TADF-sensitized fluorescence enable accelerated exciton dynamics, resulting in devices with an external quantum efficiency of 35.9% and an LT80 lifetime of 632 h.

records.title: Phase control of interfering stimulated Raman pathways in the XUV regime
records.description: Researchers modulate population transfer from the helium ground state to a metastable state by controlling the relative phase between two interfering stimulated Raman pathways through the continuum, demonstrating phase-coherent control in the extreme ultraviolet.

records.title: High-entropy molecular contacts enable high-efficiency and stable perovskite solar cells
records.description: High-entropy molecular contacts made by blending self-assembled molecules improve hole transport through diverse packing modes. Solar cells incorporating these contacts achieve a certified power conversion efficiency of 27.31% and negligible loss after 1,300 h of operation at 85 °C.

records.title: Strong coupling of photon to an electron on helium
SHINE lights up the extremes
records.description: The Shanghai High Repetition Rate XFEL and Extreme Light Facility is approaching its first lasing. Nature Photonics spoke with Zhentang Zhao, director of the Shanghai Synchrotron Radiation Facility and the SHINE project, about the facility’s capabilities and future plans.

records.title: Delaying light from quantum dots
records.description: Förster energy transfer can prolong the photoluminescence decay of a receiving colloidal quantum dot, revealing a possible route to optically control recombination in nanocrystal assemblies.

records.title: Time-stretch spectroscopy breaks temporal aliasing barrier
records.description: A temporally super-resolved single-shot method overcomes the long-standing temporal–spectral trade-off in time-stretch spectroscopy. The outcome is continuous measurements of non-repetitive spectral dynamics with picosecond resolution, providing a three-orders-of-magnitude improvement over the current state of the art.

records.title: One super sensor from many
records.description: By combining 48 parallel sensors with diffractive multiplexing to recover information from the gaps between the sensors, a new wide-field microscope achieves a spatial resolution of approximately 3 micrometres over more than 5.2 square centimetres at 120 frames per second, substantially relaxing the conventional trade-off between field of view, resolution and imaging speed.

records.title: Optomechanics for piconewton force metrology
records.description: Of the sensors that can directly sense forces in the pico- and sub-pico-newton ranges, only a few can measure in liquids. Microfibre-based microcantilevers now add to this family, providing a versatile, broad-bandwidth, high-sensitivity optomechanical sensor.

records.title: Hybrid nanophotonic trap boosts atomic storage and coherence times
records.description: A hybrid nanophotonic trap that replaces the attractive red-detuned laser field with atom–surface interactions — Casimir–Polder interactions and electrostatic attraction — achieves record-long storage and coherence times for cold atoms coupled to a nanofibre surface.

records.title: Microchip Nd:YAG laser with master-oscillator–power-amplifier architecture
records.description: This work reports an integrated Nd:Y 3 Al 5 O 12 laser–amplifier system based on a microchip master-oscillator–power-amplifier architecture. A double-resonant microring seed with a 2.9 μW threshold is combined with waveguide amplifiers, enabling continuous-wave output powers exceeding 12 dBm.

records.title: Attosecond current control and timing in a scanning tunnelling microscope
records.description: Attosecond currents are induced by two-colour pulses in a scanning tunnelling microscope (STM) junction, enabling control of their direction and resolving thermal issues inherent to laser-driven STM. Sub-angström topographic sensitivity and 2-nm lateral spatial resolution are achieved.

records.title: Giant phonon-assisted upconversion photoluminescence of in situ photo-carbonized polymer dots for 3D high-definition optical disks
records.description: Researchers demonstrate high-capacity 3D optical data storage with high efficiency enabled by anti-Stokes phonon-assisted upconversion photoluminescence via in situ laser writing and reading of upconversion carbonized polymer dots.

records.title: Trans-interface engineering for reliable perovskite solar cells with reproducible stability
records.description: Trans-interface engineering (TIE) is used to create vertically aligned soft nanolinks across perovskite and charge-transport layers, simultaneously enhancing interfacial reliability and charge transfer. The TIE-enabled perovskite solar cells achieved a certified power conversion efficiency of 26.67% and enhanced operational stability with high reproducibility.

records.title: Endlessly self-injection-locked photonic integrated lasers
records.description: Feedback-phase dispersion in a silicon nitride photonic integrated circuit enables a self-injection-locked laser to maintain its locked state at any drive current, resulting in a robust, low-noise, narrow-linewidth integrated laser.

records.title: Lattice light sheet activation structured illumination super-resolution microscopy
records.description: Lattice light sheet activation structured illumination microscopy (LA-SIM) enhances volumetric super-resolution by over twofold compared to the diffraction limit, enabling multicolour 3D imaging of subcellular dynamics in living cells and embryos

records.title: Dangling-bond-free, chemically anisotropic semiconductors for ultrahigh-resolution X-ray imaging
records.description: Zero-dimensional structured materials are proposed to eliminate dangling bonds in all crystallographic directions while driving one-dimensional columnar crystal growth without compromising electronic isotropy. An X-ray scintillator based on zero-dimensional structured Cs 2 UO 2 Cl 4 exhibits a spatial resolution of 34 lp mm −1 .

records.title: Programmable photonic unitary processor enables parameterized differentiable long-haul spatial division multiplexed transmission
records.description: A programmable photonic unitary processor for compensating modal dispersion allows long-haul (1,300 km) high-quality data transmission over a three-mode fibre.

records.title: Observation of multiphoton entanglement in resonance fluorescence
records.description: Multiphoton scattering process is extracted from the resonance fluorescence of a single 87 Rb atom. Tripartite entanglement between the photons is verified by a violation of Svetlichny’s inequality. A quantum secret sharing protocol is demonstrated as an application example.

records.title: Attosecond streaking of photoelectron angular momentum
records.description: Angle-resolved attosecond streaking measurements are performed on helium and neon to probe the evolution of continuum-electron partial waves during continuum–continuum transitions, and uncover the angular momentum of continuum-electron peaks at the crest of the electric field.

records.title: Volumetrically continuous 3D dynamic holography via cascaded light-field propagation
records.description: Cascaded light-field propagation enhances three-dimensional holography by transforming crosstalk into constructive signals. Using an untrained neural framework, the method achieves continuous projections along with improvements in contrast and spatial resolution without extensive computational demands.

records.title: Millimetre-wave generation with 18 zs Hz −1/2 timing noise floor via Kerr optical frequency division
records.description: Low-noise millimetre-waves are generated by injection-locking a Kerr microcomb to a dual-wavelength Brillouin laser, which serves as the optical reference. A timing noise floor of 18 zs Hz −1/2 is achieved. The integrated timing jitter is 135 as from 1 kHz to 1 MHz.

records.title: Inverted phosphorescent OLEDs with plasmon coupling from quantum dot interlayers for enhanced efficiency
records.description: The introduction of a layer of quantum dots reduces plasmonic losses in organic light-emitting diodes.

records.title: Photonic accelerators for AI across cloud and edge platforms
records.description: The merits of photonic accelerators for artificial intelligence applications are discussed, with an emphasis on cloud versus edge systems.

records.title: Scalable and conformal nickel oxide for efficient perovskite solar modules
records.description: A coordination-regulated chemical bath deposition method yields conformal nickel oxide layers for perovskite solar cells, enabling 27.35% certified cell efficiency, 23.42% module efficiency and durable operation.

records.title: On-chip space–time wave packet laser array
records.description: An integrated semiconductor laser array can directly generate incoherent space–time wave packets with propagation-invariant and self-healing characteristics.

records.title: Integrated electro-optic circulator on thin-film lithium niobate for bidirectional optical fibre transmission
records.description: A thin-film lithium niobate integrated circulator with peak isolation up to 37 dB and a broad transmission bandwidth supports bidirectional transmission through single-mode fibre at 800G standard throughput.

records.title: All-organic polymer with large refractive index in the near-infrared
records.description: An organic polymer with a large refractive index and excellent transparency in the infrared regime could bring new opportunities for imaging.

records.title: Mechanochromic tactile sensing
Plasma mirror self-focusing boosts gamma-ray generation
records.description: One approach to generate high-energy X-rays and γ-rays is inverse Compton scattering, where a high-energy electron beam collides with an intense laser pulse. However, this process is notoriously difficult because the electron and laser beams must be precisely aligned in space and time. Now, a coated plasma mirror is shown to dramatically increase the efficiency and energy of the generation.

records.title: A milestone toward exawatt plasma optics by Raman amplification
records.description: Exawatt-to-zettawatt lasers are essential in the quest for an ultimate understanding of nature, but they are held back by the damage limits of conventional optics. A recent experiment of Raman pulse compression to terawatt power revitalizes the prospect of plasma-based optics for next-generation ultraintense lasers.

records.title: Time to embrace new platforms
records.description: With silicon-based integrated photonics having reached commercial-level maturity, the research community is directing its efforts towards heterogeneous designs and alternative material platforms with new functionalities.

records.title: The state and prospects of the European photonics sector
records.description: At the centre of Europe’s rich photonics ecosystem, the European Photonics Industry Consortium (EPIC) connects stakeholders and promotes collective actions and advocacy. Nature Photonics spoke to its Director General Carlos Lee about recent trends, strengths and challenges facing Europe.

records.title: Doped germanium keeps pace with the light field
records.description: Attosecond transient reflection spectroscopy reveals that doped germanium can retain a light-field-driven sub-cycle optical response, with impurity doping shifting and reshaping electron dynamics on attosecond timescales.

records.title: Optical hydrogen sensing across scales
records.description: An optofluidic microcavity combined with an adaptive laser-locking scheme makes it possible to monitor hydrogen from individual molecules to per cent-level concentrations with a compact device.

records.title: Fluid motion and crystallization control enable air-processed fully screen-printed perovskite solar cells
records.description: Solvent engineering optimizes fluid motion and crystallization in fully screen-printed perovskite solar cells, resulting in devices with a certified power conversion efficiency of 21.86%, 90.5% of which is maintained after 2,000 h of operation.

records.title: Ultra-wideband electrically tuned mid-infrared on-chip parametric oscillator
records.description: A thin-film lithium niobate integrated optical parametric oscillator converts a fixed near-infrared pump into 22 THz of electrically tunable mid-infrared light, achieving both broad wavelength coverage and mode-hop-free fine-tuning.

records.title: In situ dry repair and passivation unlocks size-independent performance in Ⅲ-nitride micro-LEDs
records.description: An in situ dry repair and passivation technique is developed to overcome plasma-induced sidewall damage in nitride-based micro-light-emitting diodes (micro-LEDs), leading to external quantum efficiencies of 64.7% and 55.1% for 2-μm-sized blue and green micro-LEDs, respectively.

records.title: Ultrafast electron diffraction with MeV electron source from a laser wakefield accelerator
records.description: Researchers demonstrate that a laser wakefield accelerator-based device with a miniaturized permanent magnet beamline can generate and manipulate electron beams suitable for ultrafast electron diffraction.

records.title: Edge-on perovskite detectors with suppressed shallow traps for counting X-ray photons at medical computed tomography fluxes
records.description: The researchers use an edge-on device configuration and chloride alloying to increase the response speed of perovskite photon-counting detectors. A response time of 37 ns is achieved, and detectors with a pixel size of 200 × 200 µm 2 can count 120-kVp X-ray photons at a high flux of 2 × 10 8 photons s −1 mm −2 .

records.title: Cold-atom comagnetometry via optical control of spin states
records.description: A cold-atom comagnetometer based on the nuclear spins of 171 Yb and 173 Yb is demonstrated. A spin coherence time of 60 s is achieved for both isotopes. The 171 Yb– 173 Yb ratio of nuclear magnetic moments is determined as –0.726076(3) with a 4-ppm precision.

records.title: X-ray-driven Hanbury Brown and Twiss spectroscopy
records.description: Photon bunching is observed in the scintillation process upon excitation by X-rays. The photon intensity correlation function is measured by using Hanbury Brown and Twiss interferometry to extract the light yield and emission lifetime in scintillator materials.

records.title: Integrated optical isolators for broadband multi-laser operation
records.description: Radio-frequency electro-optic modulation enables a broadband integrated optical isolator that is magnet-free.

records.title: Correlated electrons extend X-ray high-harmonic generation beyond the single-electron limit
records.description: The researchers experimentally demonstrate that correlated electrons can propel high-harmonic emission beyond the single-active-electron limit, markedly increasing the generated photon energies. The team observes a weak secondary plateau that extends the conventional cutoff beyond 120 eV up to the water window at 280 eV.

records.title: Laser–plasma amplification of an ultrabroadband laser pulse to 0.3 TW
records.description: The researchers demonstrate amplification of an ultrabroadband pulse in a laser–plasma Raman amplifier, achieving efficiencies of up to 8.7%, final powers of up to 0.3 TW, and final pulse durations of 64 fs.

records.title: Methods, trade-offs and opportunities in high-speed optical microscopy for neural voltage imaging
records.description: The Review discusses recent advances in neural voltage imaging, with an emphasis on relevant microscopy techniques and outstanding challenges in the field.

records.title: Optical–electrical skin sensing
Breaking the power wall in programmable photonics
records.description: A non-volatile photonic gate array based on ferroelectric domain switching eliminates static power consumption, pointing towards scalable and energy-efficient photonic integrated circuits.

records.title: Valleytronics on a single chip
records.description: The integration of light-programmable valley optoelectronic nanocircuits based on two-dimensional semiconductors has been limited by complex optical readout using bulk optics. Now, a chip integrates a metasurface with a waveguide and on-chip photodetectors to generate, sort, and read out optical valley signals in the near field, all at room temperature.

records.title: The path ahead for organic photovoltaics
records.description: Nature Photonics spoke with Yongsheng Chen from Nankai University, who was recently elected an Academician of the Chinese Academy of Sciences, about milestones in organic photovoltaic research, key outstanding challenges and the breakthroughs needed to further develop the technology.

records.title: Silencing pain with infrared light
records.description: Lanthanide upconversion nanoparticles convert near-infrared illumination into local visible emission, enabling wireless optogenetic modulation of deep pain pathways.

records.title: A hot-electron-based plasmonic artificial leaf
records.description: Non-radiative plasmonic decay generates energetic charge carriers that rapidly thermalize; however, if captured quickly, these hot electrons can be harnessed for a range of applications. Now, a hot-carrier artificial leaf, made by gold-titanium dioxide plasmonic interfaces, demonstrates excellent performance for both in vivo bioelectronics and pixel-free artificial vision systems.

records.title: Attosecond leap in scanning tunnelling microscopy
records.description: Detection of attosecond transient currents at a sub-nanometre-sized gap between a probe tip and a sample is realized using tailored, two-colour, single-cycle light pulses.

records.title: Extensible universal photonic quantum computing with nonlinearity
records.description: An extensible photonic quantum computing architecture based on a fully programmable, scalable linear-optical network has been realized, and is enhanced by two addressable modules: an inline squeezing module for injecting nonlinear resources as input states and a Kerr interaction module for implementing effective nonlinear operations.

records.title: Stable low-dimensional perovskitoids for high-performance all-perovskite tandem solar cells
records.description: The introduction of trimethylphosphonium cations results in the formation of one-dimensional perovskitoid structures, enabling all-perovskite tandem solar cells with a power conversion efficiency of 30.17%, 90% of which is retained after 2,000 h of operation.

records.title: Modulating p–n transition of two-dimensional perovskites for efficient and stable perovskite/Si tandem photovoltaics
records.description: Electronically tunable 2D perovskites optimize charge extraction in wide-bandgap solar cells, enabling perovskite/silicon tandem cells with a certified efficiency of 33.64% and excellent long-term stability.

records.title: Large-scale compressive microscopy via diffractive multiplexing across a sensor array
records.description: By combining an array of 48 sensors with a diffractive mask and compressive sensing, researchers developed a 25 gigapixel-per-second computational microscope that can image at micrometre resolution across multi-centimetre areas at 120 frames per second.

records.title: Enhanced inverse Compton scattering via spontaneous focusing induced by a coated plasma mirror
records.description: It has been proposed that coated plasma mirrors could spontaneously form a focusing structure that strengthens the reflected laser intensity to enhance the efficiency of inverse Compton scattering. Now it is demonstrated that the efficiency can reach 10 −3 with photon energies extending to hundreds of megaelectronvolts at a laser power of 400 TW.

records.title: Manipulating spin dynamics via exciton–exciton interactions for bright spin light-emitting diodes
records.description: Modulating exciton–exciton interactions in hybrid chiral metal halide heterostructures suppresses spin relaxation, enabling spin light-emitting diodes that directly emit circularly polarized light with a dissymmetry factor of 0.2 and a half-lifetime of 5,000 h at an initial luminance of 100 cd m −2 .

records.title: Author Correction: Ternary self-assembled molecular contact for ambient-processed perovskite/silicon tandem solar cells
Real-time optical signal equalization with a silicon photonic spatially distributed reservoir computer
records.description: Researchers experimentally demonstrate the real-time equalization of fibre distortions using a silicon photonics chip. The team equalizes a 28-Gbps on–off keying signal and obtains bit error rates as low as 4 × 10 −7 .

records.title: Circularly polarized bulk-heterojunction memory-computing organic light-emitting diodes for a neural radiance field-based 3D display
records.description: Circularly polarized memory-computing organic light-emitting diodes integrate three-dimensional displays with memory and processing capabilities. Optimized devices achieve luminance of over 22,000 cd m −2 , dissymmetry factor of 0.92 and energy consumption down to 1.78 pJ per spike, enabling neural radiance field greyscale three-dimensional scene reconstruction.

records.title: Adaptive laser-tagging optofluidic microcavity for single-molecule hydrogen detection across a nine-decade concentration span
records.description: Laser tagging in an optofluidic microcavity enables precise hydrogen concentration detection across a broad dynamic range. Using thermal phonon transfer and dynamic resonance tracking, this spectrometry method achieves high sensitivity, low noise and effective selectivity.

records.title: Beyond quantum linear optics with adaptive boson sampling
records.description: An adaptive boson sampling architecture is developed to achieve optical evolutions beyond the usual quantum linear optics set-ups via measurement-based feedback. A set of witnesses to certify the nonlinear-optical evolution is provided.

records.title: Hybrid nanophotonic trap for cold atoms using surface forces and a blue-detuned evanescent field
records.description: A hybrid nanophotonic trap for cold caesium atoms uses surface forces for attraction and blue-detuned light for repulsion to achieve efficient loading and enhanced storage and coherence times.

records.title: Piconewton-sensitive cell stethoscope using an optical microcantilever
records.description: An optical microcantilever sensor achieves piconewton sensitivity for dynamic force measurements in liquid environments, enabling non-invasive monitoring of cellular mechanics. The stethoscope platform captures real-time dynamics for enhanced understanding of biomechanics.

records.title: Electro-optic comb-empowered measurement of the dynamic frequency of a laser
records.description: Using integrated lithium niobate electro-optic frequency combs with slightly different repetition rates, accurate tracking of the frequency variation in a frequency-modulated laser enables stable and high-precision 3D scene ranging.

records.title: Tracking electrons at the space-time limit
records.description: Atomic-scale lightwave-driven scanning tunnelling microscopy with attosecond time resolution observes individual electrons while they are tunnelling through an energy barrier.

records.title: Self-localization aids multiphoton imaging
Chiral interactions inspire investigation
records.description: A novel spectroscopic method using the interaction between light and matter via chirality was reported at the Japan Society of Applied Physics Spring Meeting.

records.title: Optical shaping of nanoplasma shockwaves
Harnessing loss for Q -modulated biosensors
records.description: A new nanophotonic sensing strategy converts even subtle refractive-index changes into large intensity variations via radiative Q -factor modulation. Implemented in a bound-state-in-the-continuum (BIC) metasurface, the concept enables ultrasensitive and scalable biosensing of only a few tens of tumour extracellular vesicles within 15 minutes.

records.title: Relativistic light springs come into focus
records.description: Ultrafast spatio-temporal shaping of ultra-intense laser pulses is an important yet challenging goal. Now, researchers have synthesized light into a spring-like form, at relativistic intensities. The advance may provide control over the angular momentum degrees of freedom of matter at relativistic intensity, leading to previously unexplored forms of laser–plasma interactions in the laboratory.

records.title: Organic cocrystals offer record photothermal conversion
records.description: Polar cocrystals made from two centrosymmetric components use quantum coherent beating to enhance photothermal conversion, setting a new high temperature for organic solids exposed to laser light.

records.title: Visualizing optical anisotropy
records.description: A non-interferometric imaging framework enables quantitative 3D reconstruction of full dielectric tensors, opening a practical route to volumetric optical measurement of biaxial anisotropy in complex materials and biological structures.

records.title: Temporally super-resolved dispersive Fourier transformation spectroscopy
records.description: Temporally super-resolved time-stretch spectroscopy is developed to sequentially measure non-repetitive spectra in a single shot. Proof-of-concept experiments reveal the spectral evolution of 25-GHz electro-optic comb pulses and distinguish spectra separated by 3 ps.

records.title: Spatiotemporal shaping of broadband helical light pulses at relativistic intensities
records.description: Researchers demonstrate the generation of helical intensity wavepackets at relativistic intensities, reaching peak values above 1.4 × 10 18 W cm − 2 . Controlled spatiotemporal orbital angular momentum, in a geometry compatible with large-scale laser facilities, is realized.

records.title: Self-organized nanoplasmonic artificial leaf for hot-carrier bioelectronic interfaces
records.description: Researchers present a hot-carrier artificial leaf optoelectronic device exhibiting linear performance over a wide range of light intensities, enabling leadless, multimodal optoelectronic modulation and pixel-less optical pattern recognition.

records.title: Deuterated compounds for organic light-emitting diodes
records.description: This Review surveys recent advances in deuterated compounds for light-emitting devices, addressing the advantages of deuteration, its working mechanisms, and prospects for wider implementation.

records.title: Overcoming the fill-factor limit of organic solar cells
records.description: The fill factor of organic solar cells is limited by field-dependent charge generation due to exciton/charge-transfer coupling. Modelling coupled with a new guest–host design enables prolonged exciton lifetime, simultaneously raising the fill factor and open-circuit voltage in organic solar cells.

records.title: A photonic integrated long-distance quantum communication network
records.description: A four-user quantum spine-leaf network over up to 540-km fibre is demonstrated using a twin-field quantum key distribution protocol. It allows the full connections between any two user pairs and is operated at a 1.25 GHz clock rate with a secret key rate of 9.38 × 10 −9 bit per pulse.

records.title: Super-Snell scanning light-field display for ultrawide-angle high-resolution glasses-free three-dimensional displays
records.description: Inspired by Snell’s window effect, a new scanning light-field architecture enables glasses-free 3D display with a 150° viewing angle and nearly 480-pixel resolution.

records.title: Author Correction: Single-shot terahertz-field-driven X-ray streak camera
Wide-temperature-range fluid-phase grain boundaries for temperature-robust perovskite solar cells
records.description: A wide-temperature-range fluid-phase molecular complex that forms dynamically adaptive grain boundaries in perovskite films enables an efficiency of 26.52% and improved thermal cycling stability in perovskite solar cells.

records.title: A super-inert near-infrared fluorescent rotaxane dye for surgical navigation
records.description: A threaded α-cyclodextrin rotaxane near-infrared (NIR) dye offers superior photostability, high solubility, negligible non-specific binding and complete renal clearance, enabling ureter imaging in mice and pigs via NIR-II imaging and clinical NIR-I laparoscopes.

records.title: Attosecond tuning of coherent electron dynamics in doped semiconductors
records.description: Attosecond light-field control in doped germanium is demonstrated, reporting sub-cycle manipulation in conductive semiconductors, establishing doping as a route towards petahertz electronics and lightwave information processing.

records.title: Crystallinity-guided hybrid conversion for efficient ultrawide-bandgap perovskites in triple-junction solar cells
records.description: Tuning the bromine/iodine ratio in evaporated inorganic framework enables the fabrication of hybrid-deposited ultrawide-bandgap perovskites and their use in perovskite/perovskite/silicon tandem solar cells with a certified power conversion efficiency of 27.53%.

records.title: Spontaneous photoblinking upconversion microscopy
records.description: Spontaneous photoblinking in Yb 3+ /Ho 3+ -codoped upconversion nanoparticles enables super-resolution imaging of biological cells with a spatial resolution down to 30 nm at excitation power densities of about 6 kW cm −2 .

records.title: Opto-magnetic hands
Watching ionization in a new light
records.description: Ultrashort MeV electron pulses are found to induce a surprisingly strong modulation in the optical transmission of common semiconductors, enabling room-temperature detection of ionizing radiation with sub-10-ps timing precision. The findings could lead to next-generation medical imaging and radiation diagnostics.

records.title: Is ball lightning a relativistic soliton?
records.description: Ball lightning is not fully understood. It has been proposed that a stable lump of electromagnetic energy, known as a soliton, could be responsible, but such structures are usually microscopic. Now, high-power laser experiments have produced millimetre-scale relativistic solitons, indicating that they could indeed explain the phenomenon.

records.title: Implosion carving shrinks 3D-printed nanostructures
records.description: Laser-patterning a swollen hydrogel followed by controlled shrinkage enables the fabrication of high-refractive-index-contrast, nanometre-scale 3D photonic structures for visible-light applications.

records.title: The thin line for optical neural networks towards broad practical relevance
records.description: Optical neural networks promise unmatched efficiency, bandwidth, and latency — critical benefits as demand for neural network hardware surges. However, their practical value for general-purpose acceleration or specialized applications must be proven under application-realistic conditions. We discuss recent insights and outline key research priorities.

records.title: Metasurfaces bridge the terahertz gap
records.description: A carefully engineered nonlinear metasurface enables widely tunable, continuous-wave terahertz emission at room temperature, offering a compact and efficient route into a long-elusive spectral region.

records.title: Time-varying photonics enables polarization control
records.description: All-optical pumping of an isotropic aluminium zinc oxide film near its epsilon-near-zero regime enables dynamic polarization control on sub-picosecond timescales by generating birefringence, dichroism and optical activity.

records.title: High-speed non-volatile barium titanate field-programmable photonic gate array
records.description: Barium titanate ferroelectric is used in photonic phase shifters arranged in a hexagonal waveguide mesh, forming a programmable photonic array. The device achieves sub-100-ns switching speeds, while each individual gate retains its state without continuous powering, enhancing overall energy efficiency.

records.title: Orbital angular momentum multiplexing diffractive neural networks for high-capacity optical inference
records.description: By exploiting optical angular momentum and developing an end-to-end auto-optimization strategy to achieve 14-fold higher mode utilization compared with manual encoding, a deep diffractive neural network enables multitask recognition of 100 object categories with an average accuracy of 72.7%.

records.title: Quantum coherent beating in polar disubphthalocyanine-fullerene cocrystals for ultrafast photothermal conversion
records.description: Quantum coherent beating and ultrafast energy transfer have been observed in a polar disubphthalocyanine-fullerene cocrystal. The temperature reached 228 °C within 5 s following 0.5 W cm −2 laser irradiation, and an equilibrium temperature of 242 °C was achieved, which is higher than those of many other organic solids.

records.title: Single-shot full-field X-ray imaging with 10-nm resolution using hard X-ray free-electron laser pulses
records.description: Using X-ray free-electron laser pulses with mirror optics to generate a sub-10-nm focal spot and an algorithm to compensate for fluctuations in illumination, this study demonstrates single-shot in-line holography for femtosecond imaging with a field of view exceeding 1 μm and a spatial resolution of 10 nm.

records.title: Crystalline symmetry breaking enables directional light emission in quantum dots
records.description: Stacking faults enhance light out-coupling efficiency in zinc-blende quantum dot light-emitting diodes. The authors report external quantum efficiencies of 34.3% and 31.0% for green CdZnSe- and InP-based quantum dot light-emitting diodes, respectively.

records.title: Ternary self-assembled molecular contact for ambient-processed perovskite/silicon tandem solar cells
records.description: A new ternary self-assembled molecular contact enables the fabrication of perovskite solar cells in ambient conditions, with perovskite/silicon tandem devices achieving a power conversion efficiency of 31.72%.

records.title: Omnidirectional ionic locking network for stable perovskite photovoltaics
records.description: Infiltrating a bifunctional spacer between perovskite grain boundaries enables perovskite solar cells with a certified power conversion efficiency of 27.01%, 90% of which is maintained after over 2,000 h of operation.

records.title: An on-chip programmable valley optoelectronic nanocircuit
records.description: An on-chip light-programmable valley optoelectronic nanocircuit enabled by meta-waveguide photodetectors integrated with transition metal dichalcogenides is demonstrated. In situ generation, selective routing and electrical readout of valley-dependent chiral photons are achieved.

records.title: Giant trion modulation in scalable monolayer MoS 2 via plasmonic HfN gates
records.description: The authors demonstrate efficient trion modulation in MoS 2 enabled by plasmonic HfN gates. A photoluminescence modulation depth of ~24% was achieved over large tunable surface areas.

records.title: Electrically programmable circularly polarized three-dimensional display
records.description: A co-assembled nanorod/nanowire layer enables red, green and blue circularly polarized LEDs with dissymmetry factors as high as 1.54. In a 64-pixel prototype display, the brightness between different polarizations can be distinguished by the naked eye.

records.title: Free-space twin-field quantum key distribution
records.description: By developing frequency locking and time synchronization between independent ultrastable lasers and atomic clocks, twin-field quantum key distribution is demonstrated over 14.2-km turbulent free-space channels, with a secure key rate exceeding the repeaterless capacity bound.

records.title: Structural exciton localization drives efficient solid-state sensitized triplet fusion upconversion
records.description: An absolute photon upconversion efficiency of 8.2% is demonstrated using a liquid triplet fusion medium that behaves as solid on excitonic timescales. The findings may drive higher efficiencies in nanoscale solid-state photochemical upconversion devices.

records.title: Ultrasensitive biosensing by radiative Q -factor modulation in strongly coupled three-dimensional bound-state-in-the-continuum metasurfaces
records.description: A Q -modulated refractometric sensing mechanism implemented in a bound-state-in-the-continuum metasurface enables the detection of lung cancer extracellular vesicles with a limit of detection down to 24 aM and high clinical diagnostic accuracy in human serum.

records.title: Isotropic shrinkage of patterned vacancies enables three-dimensional nanoprecise metastructures for visible light applications
records.description: A method that combines photopatterning with 10-fold shrinkage can fabricate three-dimensional metastructures with nanoscale features for applications with visible light.

records.title: Temporal solitons and frequency combs in quadratic resonators
records.description: Dissipative quadratic solitons and corresponding frequency combs are reviewed, along with their new applications.

records.title: Fourier ptychography sharpens terahertz imaging
Ytterbium spectroscopy for new physics searches
records.description: Highly precise measurements of inner-shell transitions in ytterbium atoms can help test our understanding of physics and the existence and properties of new fundamental particles.

records.title: A metropolitan-scale multiplexed quantum repeater with Bell non-locality
records.description: Time-division multiplexing in a metropolitan-scale quantum repeater is demonstrated. Heralded entanglement between remote quantum memories is implemented over a distance of 14.5 km, generating a Bell state with a fidelity of 78.6% with a Bell inequality violation of S = 2.22.

records.title: Unveiling the nanoscale dynamics of electroluminescence
records.description: When looked at using super-resolution optical microscopy, organic light-emitting devices are found to emit electroluminescence that is spatially heterogeneous on nanometre scales and fluctuates strongly in time.

records.title: Hard disk drive capacity limits smashed by nanofocusing of plasmons
records.description: About two decades ago, proof-of-principle demonstrations used light to enable heat-assisted magnetic recording (HAMR). Now, with over a million HAMR drives in the market, Nature Photonics spoke to Seagate VP of Research Ed Gage about what is arguably one of the greatest commercial success stories in plasmonics.

records.title: Colloidal quantum dots shine in the mid-infrared
records.description: By placing colloidal quantum dots emitting in the mid-infrared within a plasmonic resonant cavity, scientists achieve a 270-fold improvement in emission efficiency, with a power conversion efficiency of 6.8% for emission at 5 µm.

records.title: Author Correction: Quantum state processing through controllable synthetic temporal photonic lattices
Author Correction: Universal routing of light via optical thermodynamics
Wide-band millimetre-wave synthesizer using microresonator-soliton photomixing
records.description: Using a chip-based dual microresonator-soliton source with a high-speed photodetector, the authors demonstrate a CMOS-compatible generator of tunable millimetre-wave signals with low phase noise.

records.title: Molecular quantum-dot orbital hybridization supports efficient endothermic singlet exciton fission
records.description: Hybridization of molecular and quantum-dot energy levels aids singlet exciton fission.

records.title: Atomically dense Sb 2 O 3 interlayer for highly stable perovskite photovoltaic modules
records.description: An Sb 2 O 3 interlayer at the perovskite/electron transport layer interface increases the reverse-bias resistance of the cells to −22.3 V. Modules with an area of 62.37 cm 2 achieved a certified power conversion efficiency of 23.1%, 96% of which was maintained after 1,000 h of operation at 65 °C.

records.title: Narrow-bandgap acceptors with suppressed exciton thermalization loss for highly efficient perovskite–organic tandem solar cells
records.description: A new series of narrow-bandgap acceptors exploiting the heavy-atom effect enables organic solar cells with a power conversion efficiency of 20.7% and 1-cm 2 perovskite–organic tandem devices with a certified power conversion efficiency of 27.5%.

records.title: Low-noise microwaves from free-running frequency combs and electrical feed-forward phase noise compensation
records.description: Electrical feed-forward used for noise compensation in microwave signal generation provides low phase noise and timing jitter while easing the requirements of the optical frequency comb divider.

records.title: Minimizing strain for ultra-stable tin perovskite LEDs
records.description: An optimized thermal evaporation process for tin-based perovskites enables precise strain engineering in the perovskite layer, resulting in perovskite light-emitting diodes with a half-lifetime of 1,250 h at a constant current density of 100 mA cm −2 and a peak external quantum efficiency of 6.6% for emission at 944 nm.

records.title: Integrated photonics for continuous-variable quantum optics
records.description: In this Review the authors cover the latest efforts to integrate sources and detectors of continuous-variable quantum light states into chip-scale photonic integrated circuits.

records.title: Incoherent dielectric tensor tomography for quantitative three-dimensional measurement of biaxial anisotropy
records.description: The internal structure of biological samples and polycrystalline materials is visualized using incoherent dielectric tensor tomography. Through angular and polarization modulation, the method detects submicrometre optical anisotropic features—such as biaxial symmetry—that are not accessible with the coherent counterpart.

records.title: Strong ultrafast nonlinear optical response from megaelectronvolt electrons in semiconductors
records.description: Nonlinear optical responses of semiconductors induced by 150-fs and 4.2-MeV electron pulses are investigated. Sub-10-ps bandgap modulations with intensities up to 24.5% are observed near the bandgap and are explained by the band-filling effect and bandgap renormalization.

records.title: Ball-lightning-like relativistic terahertz solitons
records.description: When a femtosecond laser is focused onto a tungsten tip, excited surface plasmon polaritons form a relativistic terahertz soliton at the tip apex in a supersonic argon jet. It exhibits sustained stability over 100-ns durations and 400-μm spatial dimensions and resembles ball lightning.

records.title: Generation of continuous-wave 1–11 THz radiation with intersubband polaritonic metasurfaces
records.description: Tunable continuous-wave terahertz radiation spanning 1–11 THz is generated at room temperature via difference-frequency generation process in nonlinear metasurfaces. Microwatt-level terahertz output is achieved by pumping the metasurfaces with two milliwatt-level continuous-wave mid-infrared lasers.

records.title: Optical convolutional spectrometer
records.description: A centimetre-scale convolutional spectrometer offers high performance, low cost and ~500-nm bandwidth. The system classifies diverse solid samples and quantifies concentrations of solutions with detection accuracy surpassing commercial benchtop spectrometers.

records.title: Interferometric measurement of nuclear resonant phase shift with a nanoscale Young double waveguide
records.description: A nanoscale X-ray double-waveguide interferometer is developed to measure the phase shift due to the 14.4-keV nuclear resonance of the Mössbauer isotope 57 Fe. The phase shift is extracted from just a few single-photon interference measurements using Bayesian inference.

records.title: Internal homojunction Sb 2 Se 3 solar cell
records.description: A thermally evaporated Sb 2 Se 3 solar cell featuring an internal n-type/p-type homojunction achieves a power conversion efficiency of 10.15% with a voltage deficit of 0.459 V.

records.title: Vectorial ultrafast chiroptical microscopy
records.description: Ultrafast chiroptical signals are notoriously difficult to image in space and time simultaneously. Now, multiplexed off-axis holography, which encodes polarization information, enables ultrafast wide-field imaging of the transient optical activity, phase and absorption of samples.

records.title: Industry eyes up new laser opportunities
records.description: Photonic-crystal surface-emitting lasers look set to become the technology of choice for many high-power laser applications.

records.title: Orazio Svelto (1936–2026)
records.description: Orazio Svelto, one of the founding figures of modern laser physics, passed away on 9 January 2026, shortly before his 90th birthday. With his death, the global scientific community loses not only a pioneer whose ideas helped shape more than six decades of laser science, but also a master teacher, an institution builder, and a generous mentor whose legacy will continue to illuminate physics for generations.

records.title: Label-free super-resolution imaging of wavelength-scale areas
records.description: Limited-size object optical microscopy enables label-free, far-field super-resolution imaging of arbitrarily shaped particles, with limited size of the field of view as the only required prior knowledge.

records.title: Non-destructively measuring loss and gain in photonic chips
records.description: A non-destructive scanning method harnesses nonlinear micro-ring resonators as on-chip optical power discriminators to directly measure loss and gain of components in photonic integrated circuits with sub-0.1 dB precision.

records.title: Microlaser counts single ions
records.description: Weak optical coupling between hydrated ions and dielectric microcavities, together with pronounced drift and noise in liquids, makes optical single-ion sensing notoriously difficult. Now, a plasmon-enhanced microcavity microlaser registers individual metal-ion events in solution via shifts of a self-heterodyned beat note.

records.title: Microcombs for the generation of tunable structured microwaves
records.description: Structured microwaves emitted by a chip-based microcomb source equipped with an antenna array enable ultrahigh-capacity communications and multi-variable sensing.

records.title: Ultrafast holographic chiroptical microscopy
records.description: Encoding polarization information using multiplexed off-axis holography yields a scheme for performing ultrafast chiroptical microscopy.

records.title: All-optical polarization control in time-varying low-index films via plasma symmetry breaking
records.description: Femtosecond pumping of an isotropic low-index subwavelength film enables ultrafast polarization control, with induced birefringence up to 0.1π μm −1 , a dichroic ratio of ~23% and a non-reciprocal optical activity of ±1.1° μm −1 .

records.title: Local and remote synthesis of single-photon space-time wave packets
records.description: By projecting the multimoded, spatiotemporally structured signal photon onto a single spatial mode to herald the arrival of the idler photon, a diffraction-free single-photon space-time wave packet in the idler that did not traverse the spectral modulator is remotely prepared.

records.title: Organic intercalation strategy for efficient all-evaporated perovskite light-emitting diodes
records.description: A sequential deposition method combined with a multifunctional organic additive enables sky-blue all-thermally evaporated perovskite light-emitting diodes with a peak external quantum efficiency of 20.15%, as well as their integration into an active-matrix display prototype.

records.title: Three-dimensional super-resolution imaging with suppressed background via digital array modulation microscopy
records.description: Digital array modulation microscopy uses natural Gaussian illumination and virtual detection modulation, together with a single-spectrum reconstruction algorithm, for three-dimensional super-resolution imaging with 300-nm and 100-nm axial and lateral resolution, respectively.

records.title: Large exciton longitudinal–transverse splitting enables room-temperature ultrafast coherent polaritonics in layered perovskite crystals
records.description: The researchers demonstrate room-temperature control over bulk exciton–polaritons (EPs) in a bare halide perovskite crystal and show that long-range bulk EP propagation occurs in the ballistic regime. Furthermore, slow light is demonstrated across the visible wavelength range.

records.title: Single-atomic-ion detection with plasmon-enhanced whispering-gallery-mode microlasers
records.description: Plasmon-enhanced whispering-gallery-mode microlasers enable single-atomic-ion detection in solution. Real-time monitoring of transient and permanent interactions of zinc and cadmium ions as well as peak sensitivities with beatnote shifts of 3.7 fm for Zn 2+ and 7.2 fm for Cd 2+ are demonstrated.

records.title: A quantum walk comb source at telecommunication wavelengths
records.description: A nearly flat broadband quantum walk comb laser is demonstrated in the near-infrared region. A bandwidth of 1.8 THz with a wallplug efficiency of 6% and an ultra-narrow radio frequency linewidth of 1 Hz is achieved at the fundamental repetition rate of 1 GHz.

records.title: Orders-of-magnitude improvement in precision spectroscopy of an inner-shell orbital clock transition in neutral ytterbium
records.description: Precision spectroscopy of an inner-shell orbital clock transition in Yb is developed. It reveals the transition moment, the intrinsic lifetime of the excited state and the interorbital Feshbach resonance. Isotope shifts with uncertainties below 10 Hz are also measured.

records.title: Dipole-assisted functionalization enables long-range ordering of ZnTeSe quantum dots for efficient and stable deep-blue electroluminescence
records.description: Functionalization of ZnTeSe quantum dots via ordering arrangement and energy-level modulation enables deep-blue quantum dot light-emitting diodes with a peak external quantum efficiency of 23.6% and a half-lifetime exceeding 50,000 h at an initial luminance of 100 cd m − 2 .

records.title: Surface acoustic wave Brillouin photonics on a silicon nitride chip
records.description: Strong stimulated Brillouin scattering is incorporated in a standard silicon nitride platform via a tellurium oxide layer. The authors demonstrate applications including a silicon-nitride-based Brillouin amplifier (net optical gain, 5 dB), a compact intermodal stimulated Brillouin laser capable of high-purity radio-frequency signal generation (intrinsic linewidth, 7 Hz) and a widely tunable microwave photonic notch filter (ultranarrow linewidth, 2.2 MHz).

records.title: Experimental memory control in continuous-variable optical quantum reservoir computing
records.description: Researchers demonstrate a photonic quantum reservoir computing platform that uses spectral and temporal multiplexing in a continuous-variable setting. Real-time memory is implemented, and nonlinear temporal tasks are enabled.

records.title: Dynamic manipulation of photoluminescence in two-dimensional covalent organic frameworks
records.description: Two-dimensional covalent organic frameworks offer new opportunities for dynamic manipulation of photoluminescence, from delayed fluorescence to phosphorescence.

records.title: Degeneracy-locked optical parametric oscillator
records.description: Locking of an optical parametric oscillator’s degeneracy over a broad bandwidth enables robust operation against both pump detuning and temperature fluctuations.

records.title: Nanoscale electroluminescence inhomogeneity and blinking in organic light-emitting diodes
records.description: Super-resolution imaging of organic light-emitting diodes reveals that their electroluminescence emission is spatially non-uniform and blinking when observed at the submicrometre length scale.

records.title: Monolithic integration of continuous-variable cluster-state generation, manipulation and measurement
records.description: Quantum photonic integrated circuits are fabricated on a Si 3 N 4 chip. Squeezed light sources, quantum gates and a homodyne detection system are monolithically integrated. Individual qumodes and multi-qumode cluster states with high phase stability and fidelity are generated.

records.title: Hyperspectral quantum-dot image sensors via in-pixel reconfigurable band-alignment
records.description: Bias-voltage-tuneable colloidal quantum dots junctions enable short-wave infrared hyperspectral imagers with megapixel spatial resolution and nanometre-scale spectral resolution for food quality monitoring and materials discrimination.

records.title: Simulation of a Floquet non-Abelian topological insulator with photonic quantum walks
records.description: A three-band time-multiplexed photonic quantum walk simulates a Floquet non-Abelian topological insulator. The observation of the anomalous non-Abelian phase confirms the bulk-boundary correspondence using the topological configuration of phase-band singularities.

records.title: Ground-state exciton–polariton condensation via coherent Floquet driving
records.description: The researchers use gigahertz acoustic waves to control the gain and loss of confined modes of an exciton–polariton condensate in a microcavity, enabling dynamic population transfer. Selective transfer to the ground state yields single-level emission consisting of a spectral frequency comb with gigahertz repetition rates.

records.title: Efficient white light-emitting diodes based on all-perovskite triple-junction tandems
records.description: All-perovskite tandem white LEDs fabricated via a solid–liquid interface transfer-printing technique achieve minimized voltage loss, a peak certified external quantum efficiency of 16.4% and maximum luminance beyond 67.000 cd m −2 .

records.title: A 1-km photonic link connecting superconducting circuits in two dilution refrigerators
records.description: The microwave-to-optical transduction between two superconducting circuits over a 1-km telecom link is implemented. The transduced signal preserves classical coherence with the original microwave signal, showing the feasibility of microwave distribution via optical carriers.

records.title: Bragg crystal magnifier enables high-contrast imaging
Perovskite–silicon solar cells put to test
records.description: Amidst rapid performance improvements and industrial scaling of perovskite–silicon solar cells, researchers wait with bated breath for the outcome of reliable long-term testing. The latest updates, especially from China, were reported in Brisbane, Australia at the recent APSRC conference.

records.title: Twisted fibre photonic Chern insulator
records.description: Photonic topological structures based on solid-state Chern insulators allow light to flow in only one direction along their edges, making them intrinsically resistant to scattering and localization by imperfections. Now, a photonic version of a Chern insulator has been realized in a complex multi-core fibre.

records.title: Topological antennas empower communications
records.description: Valley dispersion engineering enables seamless transition between guided and leaky topological edge states, providing a viable route for the application of topological devices in terahertz communications.

records.title: Sub-100-nanometre quantum-dot LEDs
records.description: A capillary-driven nanoimprint technology creates high-efficiency nanoscale quantum-dot light-emitting diodes (QLEDs) with sub-100-nm pixels, enabling ultrahigh resolutions of nearly 170,000 pixels per inch (PPI) for next-generation displays.

records.title: Back-reflection immunity in CMOS photonics via engineered laser feedback
records.description: Implementing stable laser operation requires optical isolators to protect against destabilizing back-reflection signals. Now, CMOS optical circuits provide a simple and insensitive pathway towards robust protection.

records.title: Full dimensional control of structured microwaves based on microcombs
records.description: Using a chip-based microcomb, full dimensional control of structured microwaves is demonstrated, including vortex-microwave generation, submicrosecond spatiotemporal mode switching, broadband phase–frequency response tuning and wide-angle two-dimensional beam steering. These capabilities are applied in a structured-microwave-based integrated sensing and communication system.

records.title: Multiband wireless systems based on microwave integrated photonics with metasurfaces
records.description: A unified optoelectronics platform comprising dual-comb generation, modulation and metasurface-enabled beam steering serves as a transmitter for any standards between 2G and 6G. This architecture reduces power usage and costs, enabling a direct link between edge data-centre devices and the wireless network.

records.title: Isolator-free laser operation enabled by chip-scale reflections in zero-process-change silicon-on-insulator
records.description: Researchers present silicon photonic circuit that, with an integrated distributed-feedback (DFB) laser, enhances the DFB’s immunity to continuous-wave and modulated parasitic reflections from multiple reflections. The isolator-free operation of the integrated laser in a high-speed optical link was demonstrated, highlighting potential for data communication applications.

records.title: Purcell-enhanced mid-infrared cascade light-emitting diodes
records.description: The electroluminescent intraband emission of HgSe/CdS colloidal quantum dots is enhanced by plasmonic bowtie nanoantennas, resulting in light-emitting diodes emitting at 5 μm with a power conversion efficiency of 5%.

records.title: Twisted optical fibres as photonic topological insulators
records.description: In this work, researchers build a scalable photonic Chern insulator by twisting a fibre during fabrication, breaking an effective time-reversal symmetry and inducing a pseudo-magnetic field. The team reveals a ‘Goldilocks’ regime that guarantees topological protection against fabrication-induced disorder of any symmetry class in the fibre cross-section.

records.title: Programmable integrated quantum photonics
records.description: This Review covers state-of-the-art reconfigurable and tunable optical components and highlights the emergence of a set of materials that offer a new toolkit for tunability and control.

records.title: Super-resolution imaging of limited-size objects
records.description: Limited-size object microscopy (LSOM) enables label-free super-resolution imaging of isolated nano-objects with a resolution as low as λ /8 under the sole assumption of the limited size of the imaged object.

records.title: Efficient integrated quantum memory for light
records.description: Integrated quantum memories based on 151 Eu 3+ :Y 2 SiO 5 crystals coupled with impedance-matched optical cavities are demonstrated. Multiplexed quantum storage efficiencies of 80.3% and 69.8% are achieved for weak coherent pulses and telecom-heralded single photons, respectively.

records.title: Heralded high-dimensional photon–photon quantum gate
records.description: A general protocol for high-dimensional entangling gates is developed and applied for two four-dimensional qudits encoded in orbital angular momentum (OAM). The phase-locking technique stabilizes OAM sorters, leading to a process fidelity within a range from 0.71 to 0.85.

records.title: Highly sensitive and stable perovskite detector for ultrahigh-energy radiations via dynamic repair regulation
records.description: The researchers exploit lattice-anchoring-enhanced dynamic repair in organic–inorganic hybrid perovskites to demonstrate a single-crystal detector with a sensitivity of 165.6 μC mGy − 1 cm −3 and radiation stability under high-fluence 6-MeV X-rays (6.4 × 10 11 photons cm − 2 ) and 1.2-MeV electrons (6 × 10 16 electrons cm −2 ). The findings may have implications for diverse applications, including radiation therapy, astronomy and nuclear technology.

records.title: Super-broadband stimulated Raman scattering spectroscopy and imaging
records.description: A stimulated Raman scattering method based on dual-band laser-induced quantum interference enables ultra broadband and rapid hyperspectral Raman imaging of biological tissue and the detection of up to 11 key biomarkers in human serum.

records.title: Nanoscale probing of interfaces
A lens for attosecond pulses
records.description: A Hydrogen plasma that is generated with controllable density distribution can act as a lens to tightly focus extreme-ultraviolet attosecond pulses.

records.title: Lithium tantalate meets silicon photonics
records.description: Lithium tantalate (LiTaO 3 ) is heterogeneously integrated with silicon photonics circuits, enabling high modulation speed, reduced bias drift and a high optical damage threshold, while ensuring full compatibility with the existing silicon photonics process design kit.

records.title: Scaling quantum photonics networks
records.description: Mode mixing and mapping with a piece of multimode optical fibre and spatial light modulators creates a bridge between two isolated quantum networks, linking distant nodes with quantum connectivity.

records.title: Highly stable all-perovskite tandem solar cells with targeted conversion of tin–lead surfaces
records.description: Treating the tin–lead surface in perovskite films with caesium hydroxide forms solid metal oxides that stabilize the surface against photothermal degradation. When used in all-perovskite tandem solar cells, a certified power conversion efficiency of 28.56% is achieved, 90% of which is retained after 500 h of testing under ISOS-L-3 conditions.

records.title: Non-local bound states in the continuum for nanoscale alignment
records.description: Researchers study the transition from bound states in the continuum (BICs) to quasi-BIC caused by out-of-plane asymmetry and illustrate how quality factors of BIC resonances are valuable tools for precise chip patterning accuracy.

records.title: Universal loss and gain characterization inside photonic integrated circuits
records.description: A universal, non-destructive and scalable method to precisely characterize loss and gain of optical components inside photonic integrated circuits is discussed.

records.title: Dissipative solitons in mode-locked parity–time-symmetric lasers
records.description: A mode-locked laser is achieved by coupling two ring resonators in a parity–time-symmetric configuration. Stable pulses emerge through a balance of gain in one cavity and loss in the other, combined with symmetry-breaking induced by the Kerr effect.

records.title: Ultrahigh-resolution nanoimprint patterning of quantum-dot light-emitting diodes via capillary self-assembly
records.description: A nanoimprint technique exploiting capillary forces in nanohole arrays enables patterning CdSe-based quantum-dot LEDs with a resolution of nearly 170,000 pixels per inch while maintaining high average external quantum efficiencies of 17.0%, 10.5% and 5.7% for red-, green- and blue-emitting pixels, respectively.

records.title: Optical coherent perfect absorption and amplification in a time-varying medium
records.description: The researchers show that a subwavelength film of indium tin oxide, the bulk permittivity of which is strategically modulated via optical pumping, can be dynamically tuned to act as both a non-resonant amplifier and a perfect absorber. The findings extend the concept of coherent perfect absorption to the temporal domain and may enable coherent manipulation of light in Floquet-engineered complex photonic systems.

records.title: Publisher Correction: Spontaneous 2D perovskite formation at the buried interface of perovskite solar cells enhances crystallization uniformity and defect passivation
Author Correction: Stabilizing high-efficiency perovskite solar cells via strategic interfacial contact engineering
Axially chiral molecular contacts with low isomerization barriers for perovskite solar cells
records.description: A non-coplanar axially chiral molecular contact favours the crystalline growth of perovskite film and improves interfacial stability in perovskite solar cells. Small-area devices yield a certified power conversion efficiency of 26.44% and maintain 98% of it after 2,000 hours of operation.

records.title: Photostable donor–acceptor interface for minimizing energy loss in inverted perovskite solar cells
records.description: A new self-assembled monolayer at the buried interface of inverted perovskite solar cells improves photostability and favours energy transfer, resulting in devices with a certified power conversion efficiency of 27.19% and 1,500-h stability under the ISOS-L-2 protocol.

records.title: A high-speed heterogeneous lithium tantalate silicon photonics platform
records.description: Lithium tantalate is heterogeneously integrated with silicon photonic integrated circuits via a micro-transfer printing process in a manner fully compatible with existing workflows. A Mach–Zehnder modulator with an insertion loss of 2.9 dB and 70 GHz operation is demonstrated.

records.title: On-chip topological leaky-wave antenna for full-space terahertz wireless connectivity
records.description: On-chip terahertz topological leaky-wave antennas based on valley photonic crystals achieve beam scanning over 75% of the three-dimensional solid angle. The time-reversal-symmetric topological leaky-wave antenna further enables the simultaneous demonstration of real-time high-definition television streaming and 24 Gbps directional wireless data transmission in opposite directions.

records.title: Encoding and manipulating ultrafast coherent valleytronic information with lightwaves
records.description: A method to coherently manipulate excitons and perform all-optical logic operations using the valley degree of freedom in monolayer WS 2 is discussed.

records.title: Stable deep-blue organic light-emitting diodes based on sensitized fluorescence
records.description: This Review discusses recent advances in sensitized fluorescence emitters for deep-blue organic light-emitting diodes, reviewing progress in molecular design and device performance as well as key remaining challenges.

records.title: In-pixel colour correction with organic self-adaptive transistors
records.description: A colour correction array featuring red-, green- and blue-sensitive organic transistors integrated within a single pixel enables self-adaptive intensity and colour correction.

records.title: Multiplying matrices in a single pass with light
records.description: Optical computing has been limited to vector–matrix multiplications, with matrix–matrix operations requiring wavelength- or time-division multiplexing, reducing energy efficiency and speed. Now, researchers have demonstrated a free-space optical approach that overcomes these limitations, enabling parallel matrix–matrix and tensor–matrix multiplications in a single optical operation.

records.title: Electron shaping for continuous terahertz coverage
records.description: Modulating an electron beam with a frequency-beating laser enables a free-electron laser to generate high-power, narrowband terahertz pulses that can be continuously tuned from 7.8 to 30.8 terahertz.

records.title: Interlayer engineering in metal halide perovskite photovoltaics
records.description: This Review discusses recent advances in interlayer engineering for perovskite solar cells, highlighting promising materials and architectures that could improve the stability and efficiency of devices.

records.title: Silicon nitride nanocomposites at the buried interface for stable perovskite solar cells
records.description: An amorphous–crystalline silicon nitride nanocomposite at the buried interface of perovskite solar cells enables small-area devices with a certified power conversion efficiency of 26.37%. Modules with an area of 1,252 cm 2 maintain stable output for 6 months of outdoor operation.

records.title: High-harmonic generation during ultrafast melting of a Mott insulating state
records.description: High-harmonic spectroscopy under an intense mid-infrared field reveals redshifts of high-harmonic peaks during the ultrafast melting of a Mott insulating state, while dynamical mean-field theory links them to cycle-by-cycle electronic-state changes.

records.title: All-optical thin-film lithium niobate memristor
records.description: Oxygen-ion implantation allows the direct fabrication of photonic memristors in thin-film lithium niobate. The resulting devices combine 3-bit non-volatile optical memory, submicrosecond responses and femtojoule-level switching energies.

records.title: Pure-blue quantum-dot light-emitting diodes with minimal efficiency roll-off and high brightness
records.description: Quantum dots with compositionally graded shells enhance quantum-dot LED performance, achieving pure-blue emission with a peak external quantum efficiency of 23.8%, 95% of which is retained at a luminance of 50,000 cd m −2 .

records.title: Light-switch for nerve cells
Optical control stabilizes cold-atom comagnetometry
records.description: The use of tailored laser fields improves the coherence times of two co-trapped ytterbium isotopes, resulting in the rejection of magnetic-field noise by more than thirty-thousand-fold, opening the way to improved comagnetometry.

records.title: Measuring hard X-ray attosecond pulses
records.description: The generation and characterization of high-power X-ray attosecond pulses is a challenging research frontier in free-electron laser science. Now, researchers at the Linac Coherent Light Source have demonstrated experimental confirmation and measurement of hard X-ray pulses reaching 100-attosecond durations.

records.title: Femtosecond lasers drive nanostructuring and green applications
records.description: From ultra-precise nanofabrication to sustainable use cases, femtosecond lasers continue to expand their application potential.

records.title: Workhorse solid-state lasers reinvented
records.description: Miniature versions of famous bulk solid-state sources, notably titanium–sapphire and Nd:YAG lasers, have now become a reality. This advance has been made possible through collaborative efforts from material science, heterogeneous integration and fabrication technologies.

records.title: Infrared polymer boasts high index and transparency
records.description: A bifunctional cyano-substitution synthetic strategy yields an all-organic polymer with a record-breaking refractive index of 2.53 at 750 nm, combining high infrared transparency with mechanical flexibility and solution-processability.

records.title: Low-voltage avalanche heterojunction phototransistor for infrared-to-visible upconversion
records.description: Researchers demonstrate infrared-to-visible upconversion using an InGaAs/InP avalanche heterojunction phototransistor. Intrinsic positive feedback provides the photocurrent for amber LED operation, producing visible emission 17,000 times brighter than incident infrared light with a breakdown voltage as low as 1.4 V.

records.title: Deep subwavelength laser nanofabrication via upconversion
records.description: Upconversion brings new opportunities for high-resolution laser fabrication.

records.title: Automatic on-chip separation of partially coherent light into its mutually incoherent components
records.description: Partial coherence often limits imaging and optical information processing. Researchers demonstrate a photonic chip that separates partially coherent light into its coherence modes, enabling scalable coherence analysis with resources that scale linearly with mode rank.

records.title: Ligand-engineered CsEuI 3 nanocrystals for efficient single-component white electroluminescence
records.description: Ligand-engineered CsEuI 3 nanocrystals enable efficient single-component white electroluminescence with a peak external quantum efficiency of 8.3% and integration into active-matrix full-colour displays.
